typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EmailMessageBody as string (),
	EmailSubject as string (),
	ExtractFolder_Path as string (),
	ExtractName as string (),
	FailureEmail as string (),
	File_Name as string (),
	File_name_seq as integer (),
	File_Naming_Convention as string (),
	ID as integer (),
	RecordCnt as integer (),
	ReportDate as string (),
	RportDate_Prev as string (),
	StoredProc as string (),
	StoredProcExec as string (),

	SuccessEmailTO as string ()
}

source(output(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::StoredProcExec',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource1

		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
